verdicts.reason: A breaks the design. The quote-mark glyphs are blown up into huge dark blocks that compete with the quote, and the hero photo shrinks to a thumbnail, losing the key imagery. The author box is stretched across the canvas with 'G.M. ALLEN' at an unreadable size, and the photo, quote marks and box are jammed together along the bottom. B keeps the original's split layout, photo proportions, framed inset and hierarchy intact, adapted cleanly to the slightly taller canvas. Its only flaws are minor: some extra dead space under the quote and the photo still bleeding off the left edge as in the original.
